name: terminal-harbour
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP;for(const n of ['WaterfrontLandmarks_QQT_ClockDial','WaterfrontMainBuilding','WaterfrontHarbourfront','WaterfrontConcertStage'])if(!a.scene.getObjectByName(n))throw Error('Missing '+n);const i=C.GEO.buildings.findIndex(b=>Math.abs(b[0]+359.7)<.1&&Math.abs(b[1]-591.6)<.1);if(i<0||!C.waterfrontMainBuildingExcludesBuilding(i))throw Error('Mapped entry canopy not replaced');if(!C.waterfrontConcertStage?.active||!C.concertStageSurfaceAt)throw Error('Stage not active');return{stage:C.waterfrontConcertStage.stats,main:C.waterfrontMainBuilding?.stats,powerPlant:C.waterfrontHarbourfront?.stats.powerPlant};})();document.body.classList.add('film');window.__CITY_APP.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({"pos": [-190, 9, 820], "look": [-205, 22, 675], "fov": 60})

name: stage-ramp-walk
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,L=C.waterfrontConcertStage.layout,r=L.ramp,d=L.deck,f=L.frame;let y=0,p; a.selectMode('person');const u=(r.u0+r.u1)/2;for(let i=0;i<=80;i++){const v=r.vBottom+(r.vTop-r.vBottom)*i/80;const[x,z]=C.concertStageLocalToWorld(f,u,v);const surface=C.concertStageSurfaceAt(x,z,{baseY:y,maxRise:.6});const h=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person',y);if(!surface||Math.abs(h-surface.h)>.015)throw Error('Stage ramp footing '+i+' '+h+' '+surface?.h);p=new C.THREE.Vector3(x,h,z);a.controllerManager.resolveHorizontalCollision(p,.28);if(Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z)>.09)throw Error('Stage ramp blocked '+i);y=h;}const[x,z]=C.concertStageLocalToWorld(f,u,d.v0+.25);const h=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person',y);if(Math.abs(h-d.lift)>.015)throw Error('Stage deck height mismatch');a.teleportTo(x,z,0,h);a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x+6,h+3,z-6],look:[x,h+.8,z+6],fov:60});return{samples:81,deckHeight:h,rampGrade:r.grade};})()
